description: This file defines an interface for creating server request objects in a PSR-17 compliant HTTP message factory. It declares a method for creating server requests that adhere to a specified interface, with detailed parameter explanations.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactoryInterface
classes.description: Defines a contract for creating server request instances, allowing implementations to generate requests based on given HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new server request with specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters, returning an instance that conforms to ServerRequestInterface.
